dialect.label: Mitsubishi M800/M80 lathe, G code list 3, 5 or 7
dialect.about: A Mitsubishi lathe whose cmdtyp parameter picks G code list 3, 5 or 7, close to Fanuc system B: G33 threads, G77/G78/G79 cycles, G92 spindle clamp, G94/G95 feeds.

source.manual: Mitsubishi M800/M80/E80/C80 Series Programming Manual, Lathe System IB-1501275-U

G32.text: In G code system B threading is G33, not G32 (system A).

G50.text: In G code system B G92 sets coordinates and the spindle limit; G50 is system A.

G98.text: In G code system B G98/G99 pick the drilling cycle return level; feed per minute and per rev are G94/G95.

G99.text: In G code system B G98/G99 pick the drilling cycle return level; feed per minute and per rev are G94/G95.

G33.desc: Single thread cut (systems B and C)

G92.desc: Clamp spindle to a max RPM (G50 in system A)

G92.shift.desc: Set the coordinates: the tool's current position becomes the X and Z on this line, shifting the zero (with G91, by the amounts given)

G98.desc: Drilling cycle returns to the start level

G99.desc: Drilling cycle returns to the R level
